positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implementation of Google Assistant on the Fuchsia operating system - now running on Nest Hub devices

- End-to-end automated testing of assistant on devices and emulators

positions.title: Senior GUI Developer
positions.description:
- Performed analysis and refinement of feature requirements for both internal and external customers for math and engineering software. For example, analyzed potential methods for math document interaction and presented feasible options given existing design constraints
- Designed and implemented numerous user interface components, including toolbars, and custom look and feels
- Implemented software features using Java, Swing, and GWT
- Developed tests using JUnit and Selenium and proposed software design changes that would improve testability, including the use of dependency injection and frameworks such as Guice

positions.title: PhD Candidate
positions.description:
Dissertation: Developing Rule-Based Training within the Cognitive Work Analysis Framework

- Studied the analysis of requirements for complex systems, particularly in relation to user instruction and training
- Conducted extensive literature reviews into complex system analysis
- Executed four empirical research studies concerning instructional design, including observations of computer users' interactions with a system and controlled experiments to compare the effectiveness of various types of instructional designs
- Worked on a side project to develop Java- and iOS- based medical software that assists doctors with the monitoring of rheumatoid arthritis progression
- Degree successfully completed in September 2013

positions.title: Intermediate GUI Developer
positions.description:
(2005-2008 Full Time)
(2008-2011 Part Time - NSERC Industrial Postgrad Scholarship)

- Analysed design requirements and implemented new software features using Java
- Implemented user interface features for both desktop (using Java) and iOS platforms (using Cocoa Touch and OpenGL)  
- Developed 2D plotting engine for mobile devices after analysing implementation options (Quartz 2D or OpenGL) 
- Redeveloped 3D plotting engine, using OpenGL and JOGL, to boost speed of plotting and improve interactions with plots

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description:
(Spring terms 2004 and 2005)

- Taught courses covering topics such as data structures, algorithm analysis, and software engineering
- Developed lectures, assignments, and exam questions

positions.title: Camp Counsellor/Leader in Training
positions.description:
(Summers 1995-1997, 2002) 
 
- Developed my leaderships skills by working with campers to help them decide on activities and schedules for their week at camp
- Worked in small teams of 3 to 4 staff members, resulting in improved teamwork skills
- Implemented a program for older campers to further engage them in planning their own camp activities

positions.title: Programmer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed interface prototypes for two Fortune 500 companies
- Worked in a small team to make interface-design decisions to simplify a boolean search tool
- Developed user interfaces using Java and JSPs

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Co-op student for 3 terms (excluding Sept - Dec 1999)

- Designed and implemented user interface prototype for web-based banking service software used in TD Canada Trust bank branches
- Implemented application features for RRSP planning software using Java and Swing

positions.title: Programmer/IT support
positions.description:
- Developed in house software for shipping and invoicing
- Provided IT support to office staff
- Purchased new computer hardware

honors.title: Descartes Math Contest - Certificate of Distinction
Harvard Model United Nations - Best Delegate
